description: This file defines the ProxyChangeListener class which listens for system proxy change notifications on Android and communicates these changes to native code. It handles different Android API levels, uses reflection to access non-exported classes, and manages broadcast receivers for proxy updates.

classes.name: ProxyChangeListener
classes.description: Main class that listens for Android system proxy changes and communicates with native code.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: Immutable class representing proxy configuration details such as host, port, PAC URL, and exclusion list.

classes.name: ProxyReceiver
classes.description: Inner class extending BroadcastReceiver to handle proxy change broadcasts.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables proxy change listening globally.

methods.name: setDelegateForTesting
methods.description: Sets a delegate for testing purposes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ProxyChangeListener.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts listening for proxy change events, associating with a native pointer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening for proxy change events.

methods.name: extractNewProxy
methods.description: Extracts proxy configuration from an Intent, using reflection for non-exported classes.

methods.name: proxySettingsChanged
methods.description: Notifies native code of a proxy configuration change.

methods.name: getProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current proxy configuration using Android APIs, with special handling for Android Q+.

methods.name: updateProxyConfigFromConnectivityManager
methods.description: Updates proxy configuration based on connectivity manager info.

methods.name: registerBroadcastReceiver
methods.description: Registers broadcast receivers for proxy change notifications.

methods.name: onThread
methods.description: Checks if current thread is the listener's thread.

methods.name: assertOnThread
methods.description: Asserts that current thread is the listener's thread.

methods.name: runOnThread
methods.description: Runs a Runnable on the listener's thread.
